newsitem.title: USA: Illinois ends FY 1997 with $805 mln balance.
newsitem.headline: Illinois ends FY 1997 with $805 mln balance.

text.p: Illinois ended fiscal 1997 with an $805 million cash balance, which exceeded May projections by $85 million from unusually strong late-year income tax revenue growth, the governor's office said.

"We have reason to be pleased and optimistic about revenue growth, but we must also be cautious not to spend money we don't have," Edgar said in a statement. "Much of the $805 million in the year-end balance is money that has already been appropriated."
Edgar also is considering legislation with tax cuts and exemptions of more than $200 million that was not included in the fiscal 1998 budget, he added.
